{{Quote|It takes an anti-magnetic polarization ray to put those things in their place!|Denid|<ref name="marvel49">[[Star Wars (1977) 49|''Star Wars'' (1977) 49]]</ref>}}
The '''anti-magnetic polarization ray gun''' was a weapon devised by [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Denid]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tantajoc V]]. The weapons were necessary to destroy the [[Tantajoc V predator|local predators]] which had a powerful healing mechanism that made them immune to most attacks. When Denid was finally discovered by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], he used this type of weapon to kill a predator that was pursuing the two [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]].<ref name="marvel49" />
